// Generated by Lakar from component "Tombol solid". Requires Tailwind CSS v4 and theme.css (imports tokens.css).
import type { CSSProperties } from 'react';

export type TombolSolidProps = {
  tone?: "solid" | "ghost";
  label?: string;
  className?: string;
  style?: CSSProperties;
};

export function TombolSolid({ label = "Button", className, style }: TombolSolidProps) {
  return (
    <div className={`relative flex flex-row p-[8px_16px] bg-[#111111] rounded-[8px] box-border m-[0] flex-[0_0_auto] ${className ?? ''}`.trimEnd()} style={style}>

        {label}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

export default TombolSolid;
